WaitingOrder.title: WaitingOrder
WaitingOrder.description: Client website request submitted from the public inquiry form into the waiting orders queue.

contactInfo.description: Client WhatsApp number or email address.

notes.description: Optional project details written by the client.

status.description: Current workflow state of the waiting order.

lang.description: Language active when the client submitted the request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was last updated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was recorded.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Studio administrator directory. Only readable by the verified owner.
